name: F#
typeSystem: Static, strong, Hindley-Milner-based type inference in the ML tradition, running on the .NET type system, with algebraic data types, units of measure, and full interoperability with C# and other .NET languages.
runtime: .NET CLR (JIT and Native AOT), garbage-collected, sharing its runtime with C#.

runtimes.name: .NET runtime (CoreCLR/RyuJIT)
runtimes.role: Primary runtime; F# compiles to the same CIL bytecode as C# and shares its JIT.

runtimes.name: Native AOT
runtimes.role: Publishes AOT-compatible F#/.NET applications as self-contained native binaries; compatibility depends on the code and its dependencies.

runtimes.name: Fable
runtimes.role: Community compiler that targets JavaScript/TypeScript for front-end use.

compilers.name: F# compiler (fsc)
compilers.role: Reference compiler; F# source to CIL bytecode.

asyncRuntimes.name: .NET ThreadPool
asyncRuntimes.role: Default scheduler for F#'s async workflows, shared with the rest of .NET.

concurrencyModel: async {} computation expressions, which helped inspire the distinct task-based async/await design in C# and Visual Basic; MailboxProcessor agents for actor-style message passing; and full access to the .NET Task Parallel Library.
